inputScope.notUniversalReqParam: Arbitrary GET request bodies and every theoretical Sails req.param source are not a compatibility promise. Send read inputs through the declared path/query transport.

intentionalBreaks.disposition: 400 for arrays/objects where a scalar is declared; declared list/JSON fields remain supported
Per-route schema projection, passthrough or rejection; arbitrary record metadata remains domain data, not a globally stripped query field
Declared integer/range limits, positive page/row sizes and nonnegative offsets; reject numeric prefixes and malformed scalar transports
Registered named operations replace evaluated service expressions; unknown operations are not compatibility regressions
Legacy virtual HTTP subscribe/unsubscribe is retired (410); direct Socket.IO grants and separate Companion WebSocket protocol are explicit contracts

browser.policy: Own browser controller/helpers never reference api.max_requests. Preserve the incoming native maxSearchRows policy (default 1000000) for browser lists/deleted lists; do not introduce the REST API cap.

recordListLimitOwnership.disposition: Supporting correction to the existing API-limit fix, not a separate incoming defect; parent fix f1da6196e.
